untrustedWorkspaces.description: Fabr runs the project's own build code, so it starts only in a trusted workspace.

fabr.command.description: The command running the project's fabr; a leading ./ is the workspace folder. A lone .js file (fabr's bin/fabr.js) runs on VS Code's own Node.js. Empty: the project's installed fabr, run so, else fabr on the PATH.
